integrity: Proof and independently propagated moment checker supplied; numerical tests are supporting evidence, not exhaustive proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Free one-dimensional RTP, finite horizon, deterministic inhomogeneous Poisson flips, no Brownian noise or confinement; older unrestricted exponential-kernel capacitary measure is prior art. Priority of the exact lower-density-constrained optimum deserves independent assessment.
title: Sharp rate-cap transition for finite-horizon dispersion in a telegraph swimmer
